result.summary: The page is largely functional and visually coherent. The main observations are the expected right-edge clipping of horizontally scrollable rows and minor promotional-banner text formatting inconsistencies.

issues.description: The category filter chip row and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel are clipped at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: These are horizontally scrollable rows, so verify that they scroll smoothly and that the clipped items can be fully revealed; otherwise reduce item widths or add edge padding.

issues.description: The promo banner text uses mixed casing ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'min. order €10') which looks inconsistent with the rest of the polished UI, and the code 'TALLINN3' is presented in uppercase without visual emphasis.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the banner typography and highlight the promo code so users can easily copy it.
